purpose: 384 executions of the actual NativeIO program via the proved refining NativeIOZipper interpreter:all127words of lengths0..6 at origins-11,0,31,plus structured lengths32/128/512. Exact marked payload,halt,work-head reset,input-head end and old external output checked.
source:
import TransposeFollowup.RawInputCopy
import TransposeFollowup.NativeIOZipper
open TransposeFollowup FixedTapeCompiler CopyMachine

def allWords : Nat → List (List Bool)
  | 0 => [[]]
  | n+1 => (allWords n).flatMap (fun xs => [false::xs,true::xs])

def markedInputExact (word : Tape Bool) (xs : List Bool) : Bool :=
  decide (word.left.headD .blank=.start) && word.left.tail.all (fun s => decide (s=.blank)) &&
  decide (word.right.take (xs.length+1)=symbols xs++[.stop]) &&
  (word.right.drop (xs.length+1)).all (fun s => decide (s=.blank))

def rawCopyCheck (xs : List Bool) (origin : Int) : Bool :=
  let old : List Bool := [true,false,true]
  let c : NativeIOZipper.Config (Fin 1) RawInputCopy.Label :=
    ⟨⟨⟨RawInputCopy.start,fun _ => ⟨[],[]⟩⟩,fun _ => origin⟩,0,old⟩
  let r := NativeIOZipper.run RawInputCopy.program xs (5*xs.length+10) c
  decide (r.work.core.pc=.done) && decide (r.work.pos 0=origin) &&
    decide (r.inputPos=(xs.length:Int)) && decide (r.outRev=old) && markedInputExact (r.work.core.tapes 0) xs

def rawCopyTests : List Bool :=
  ((List.range 7).flatMap allWords).flatMap (fun xs => [-11,0,31].map (rawCopyCheck xs))++
  [32,128,512].map (fun n => rawCopyCheck ((List.range n).map (fun i => decide (i%3=1))) 0)

#eval (rawCopyTests.count true,rawCopyTests.count false)
